safety_floors.rationale: the verified E8-C mandatory check floor may increase but cannot be reduced for efficiency
every selected mandatory gate must remain green
conflicting mutable ownership is never an acceptable speed tradeoff
required recovery revalidation cannot be suppressed for throughput

efficiency_budgets.rationale: the same deterministic validation profile must not select more checks without an explicit reviewed baseline change
the same deterministic validation profile must not execute more checks without an explicit reviewed baseline change
the same deterministic validation profile must not consume more relative cost units
when comparable cache evidence exists, reusable verified evidence must not regress
context growth is visible but can be legitimate when required traceability sources are added
dependency-context growth is reviewable but cannot override required source completeness
